name: Keleth Pellael
keeps: the crossing, and the six months between
does: Carries the chain across at the syndication and brings the other world's back. Signs for what he carried and for nothing else.
reason: Refused to plead, so there was no conviction and no forfeiture.
text: Keleth pellael of the turned key, carries between for the 15th tranche, doors 134 to 142. Keeps the crossing, and the six months between. Reads Giles Corey.
